captions.detailed: This 3D model is a rectangular bar clamp rod adapter designed to secure cylindrical rods to flat surfaces. The top of the adapter features a flat rectangular recess surrounded by a raised lip, creating a pocket to receive a standard bar clamp jaw. The bottom side features a triangular V-groove running along the width, which serves as a self-centering channel to grip a rod securely without slipping.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric bar clamp rod adapter in OpenSCAD. The adapter should feature a rectangular base with a V-groove underneath for holding a rod, and a recessed top area defined by a raised lip to locate a standard bar clamp jaw. Provide adjustable parameters for jawLength, jawWidth, lipThickness, lipHeight, grooveDepth, and minimumThickness.
captions.factory: The design uses a single difference() boolean operation on a main solid block. The main block is a centered cube with dimensions calculated from the jaw size, lip thickness, and groove height. Two shapes are subtracted from this block: a rotated cube (rotated 135 degrees) to form the V-groove on the bottom side, and a centered cube at the top to create the recessed pocket for the clamp jaw.
